title: The FAQ answers how much of it you have to run yourself
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing
- **Runs in parallel with:** the ladder story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The FAQ already answers where the computer runs. With the ladder on the page, that answer is now incomplete in a way that matters: it says where, not who operates it.

Questions to add or extend:

- Do I need an AWS account? Yes, for every rung except forking it, and here is roughly what it will cost you.
- What happens if I stop paying? Your deployment is in your account and stays there. We stop operating it. Nothing is deleted by us.
- What does managed actually mean? We apply updates, we watch it, and we go first — our own organizations take every release before yours.
- Can I start self-setup and move to assisted? Yes, and the reverse.

The stop-paying answer is the one worth writing carefully. It is the strongest thing on the page and almost nobody asks it out loud.

**Done when:** the scenario exists and fails for the right reason.
